storyline.real: Irvine holds Häkkinen up behind Schumacher's Ferrari until Häkkinen passes him at the chicane on lap 14. Ferrari bring the leader in first, on lap 24, with Häkkinen 3.5 s behind; McLaren keep Häkkinen out until lap 28 and he rejoins ahead by under a second. He comes out of the second stops 2.9 s clear and wins by 2.2 s, four points ahead with one race to go.

eras.briefing: Nürburgring, 1998, with two races left in the title fight. Schumacher took pole, and Irvine's Ferrari kept Häkkinen behind until lap 14. You run Häkkinen, second after 21 laps and 6.9 s behind Schumacher, both on two stops. Ferrari will pit first: jump the leader in the stops and win.
